text:
alex: Quick thought — can we add a tiny clarifier under the stat, e.g. `p95 (95th percentile latency)` so product folks and PMs stop asking what p95 means?

ben: 100% yes. also the heatmap ramp is a bit too punchy at the top end. feels alarmist. softer orange -> deep red would read better.

cara: palette idea: throwing some tokens here so we can iterate quickly:
```css
--heat-low: #ecf7ff;
--heat-mid: #fff2d9;
--heat-high: #ffd0b2;
--heat-extreme: #d64a4a;
```
Not final — just something to test contrast.

morgan: a11y note: any annotation text needs >=3:1 contrast at small sizes. Also add explicit keyboard support for the scrubber and preset chips (aria-labels + focus styles).

alex: for the time picker UX: people keep toggling between quick ranges and custom. What about a tiny "Recent" toggle that snaps presets to more aggressive sampling (lower sampling rate) for live dashboards? keeps defaults simple.

ben: sampling controls: we've been debating slider vs presets. I'd vote for presets (Low / Medium / High fidelity) + an "Advanced" chevron that reveals a fine-grained slider. Most users pick preset, power users can tune.

cara: copy nit: the p95 hover currently just says "p95 latency" — change to "Latency — p95 (95th percentile) · units: ms" and put the timestamp underneath. less ambiguous.

morgan: layout question: do we overlay the p95 line on the heatmap or put separate sparkline above? Overlay saves vertical space but can obscure bucket colors. Maybe overlay by default with a toggle to disable for clarity.

alex: agreed. default overlay on desktop; off on <768px. We should test with real traces to ensure the line is visible against the ramp.

cara: prototyping link (work-in-progress): https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/latency-inkblot?node-id=42 — has overlay + presets + the small copy changes.

designbot: @alex prototyping build deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.dev/latency/ux/1979994321 (snapshot). Preview includes heatmap palette toggle and the presets dropdown.

ben: can you run an a11y contrast pass on the staging palette? if background buckets drop below 3:1 we should increase saturation or add a subtle outline to extreme buckets. Also preset chips need a clear keyboard focus (2px outline). :thumbsup:

morgan: will do contrast checks and add keyboard flow tests. i'll post results and suggested token overrides as a PR.

alex: quick owners: cara — copy + figma updates; ben — palette + contrast checks; morgan — keyboard/a11y flow + scrubber focus states. Can we sync Wed 10am for a quick review?

cara: yes, i'll add comments in Figma before EOD and draft the tooltip text.

ben: on it — i'll push a small token file and run the palette through Deque Color Contrast.

designbot: Note: user-testing slot booked Wed 11:15 (30m) with 4 engineers and 2 PMs — recording enabled.

alex: perfect. thanks everyone!
